# x402 Color Converter

Deterministic color space conversion for agents.

POST /api/color
Body examples:
  {"hex": "#ff5500"}
  {"rgb": [255, 85, 0]}
  {"hsl": [20, 100, 50]}

Returns hex + rgb + hsl in one response.
Price: ~$0.006 USDC on Base (x402)

Free discovery: GET /catalog
No human in the loop. Stateless. Agent-native.
